note: Which model binding each SDLC tier runs on, and the separation rules a run must satisfy. SDLC.md states the tiers and the dyads in prose; nothing bound them to an executing model, so every launch inherited whatever model the host happened to offer. The bindings below were measured on the owner's RTX 5080 (16 GB) rather than chosen from parameter counts: see selection_evidence. This table holds no standing; SDLC.md remains authoritative and scripts/sov_loop.py refuses when a run disagrees with it.

refusal_codes.TIER_DEPTH_REFUSED: The run declares a chain that is not exactly Control, Orchestration, Work.
refusal_codes.GRANT_NOT_NARROWED: A tier claims a capability its parent did not hold, or fails to narrow.
refusal_codes.SELF_SETTLEMENT_REFUSED: The actor that produced a report also settled it.
refusal_codes.SELF_WITNESS_REFUSED: The binding that produced an output also observed it.
refusal_codes.EFFECT_CLASS_REFUSED: A tier declared an effect class above its ceiling, or one Phase I refuses.
refusal_codes.PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE: A model invocation omitted a declared provenance field.
refusal_codes.BINDING_UNDECLARED: A tier named a binding this table does not declare.

observation.note: Observation is a stance, not a fourth tier. The rule it must satisfy is that the binding observing an output is not the binding that produced it.

selection_evidence.host: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080, 16 GB VRAM; Intel i9-14900K; 32 GB RAM
selection_evidence.method: Each candidate was graded on how many of five planted defects it named in a plausible-looking worker report, and each pair was tested for whether both models stay resident at once. Parameter count did not predict either.

co_residency.lfm2.5:8b + qwen3:4b: refused: qwen3:4b takes 12.74 GB of KV cache and evicts lfm2.5

findings: lfm2.5:8b matched gpt-oss:20b's worst-case probe score on half the VRAM and 2.5x the throughput, so the larger model earns nothing here.
qwen3.5:9b is newer and larger than lfm2.5:8b and scored lower, 3/5 against 4/5.
The two chosen bindings come from different vendors, so the observer's blind spots are not the worker's.
selection_evidence.residual: Marker-based grading is coarse and can miss a correct objection phrased unusually, so each score is a floor. No candidate caught all five defects in every sample.
